summary: Reproduced CudaSRTPlatform.supports_fp8() returning true for controlled CUDA capabilities 7.5, 8.0, 8.9, and 9.0, and reproduced that the channelwise fallback still called torch._scaled_mm. The candidate makes supports_fp8() describe native CUDA FP8 GEMM (SM 8.9+) while explicitly separating that from FP8 storage/conversion, and implements the fallback as FP32 dequantization plus torch.mm. ROCm's conservative platform flag is unchanged; both the software fallback and ROCm torch._scaled_mm were executed on the assigned MI350X.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual checked-out CudaSRTPlatform API returned true for mocked capabilities 7.5, 8.0, 8.9, and 9.0; a forced unsupported torch._scaled_mm error escaped _apply_fallback_scaled_mm. Raw output: reports/j-be029f29005d/raw/before_reproduction.txt

Three focused tests passed with six capability/dtype subtests, including the 7.5/8.0 false and 8.9/9.0 true platform decisions, the no-_scaled_mm software fallback, and scalar/prequantized scale behavior. Raw output: reports/j-be029f29005d/raw/focused_tests_final.txt
All 60 platform tests and 25 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-be029f29005d/raw/platform_tests.txt

The new fallback test and four other tests passed. Existing environment-dependent tests failed because deep_gemm and CUDA-only fp8_scaled_mm symbols are absent on this ROCm checkout; the run also exposed the scalar-scale fallback edge case, which was fixed and passed in the focused rerun. Raw output: reports/j-be029f29005d/raw/fp8_utils_tests.txt

On AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, the software fallback completed without calling torch._scaled_mm and matched an independent NumPy dequantized GEMM reference with max absolute error 0.0. The installed ROCm torch._scaled_mm also produced a finite 16x16 result. Raw output: reports/j-be029f29005d/raw/rocm_gpu_validation.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X was used for FP8 tensor conversion, the new software fallback, NumPy-reference comparison, and a native ROCm torch._scaled_mm call.

remaining_limitations: No physical NVIDIA GPU was assigned. CUDA SM 7.5, 8.0, 8.9, and 9.0 results are controlled probes through the actual CudaSRTPlatform implementation, not physical NVIDIA qualification.
The CUDA platform threshold describes native hardware FP8 GEMM capability; CUDA toolkit/library availability remains the responsibility of the selected kernel backend.
The full quantization test module cannot pass in this prepared ROCm environment because optional deep_gemm and CUDA-only fp8_scaled_mm symbols are unavailable.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
